messages:
elaine: Heads-up — spotted a bad kv-cache cost snippet in the console observability dashboard guide. It inflates the cost estimate by 10x. I opened a quick PR but docs CI is failing linkcheck. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/728

mike: ack. can you paste the failing snippet here so i can triage?

julia: i'll help — might be a tiny copy/paste bug.

elaine: ```js
// old snippet in docs/console/kv-cache.md
const costPerToken = 0.00006;
const tokens = estimateTokens(resp);
const estimated = tokens * costPerToken * 10; // stray *10 bug from burst example
console.log(estimated);
```

mike: yep that's the *10. easy fix — remove multiplier. also the image link at line ~128 is 404 which is why linkcheck fails: /examples/cost-heatmap.png -> 404.

sam: also noticed the tracing hook example in the same guide still references header `x-trace-id`. our new tracing pipeline expects `x-rd-trace`. dashboards miss ~20% of spans because of that.

docs-bot: link-check failed: /docs/console/kv-cache.md line 128 -> 404 /examples/cost-heatmap.png

mike: i'll add a redirect and update the example image name. @julia can you push the snippet fix to the PR?

julia: pushed amendment to PR, removed the *10 and updated the code block. also added an explicit note about `x-rd-trace` in the tracing hook section. CI rerunning. PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/728/files

elaine: thank you. can we also include a micro SDK example showing how to call the latency/cost breakdown endpoint (python + node)? it'd help prevent future copy/paste errors.

sam: i'll create a tiny python snippet in a follow-up PR. minimal surface area, just show p50/p95 extraction.

mike: leaving a couple inline comments about wording in the cost table (p99 vs p95 clarification). once wording + sample land i'm happy to approve.

julia: heads-up — linkcheck still flags one asset (the heatmap). i added a TODO in the PR description to replace the image and a short alt-text so the validator is happier.

mike: i've added a repo-level redirect for /examples/cost-heatmap.png -> /assets/images/cost-heatmap-v2.png and updated the docs link. pushing that now.

devops-bot: prod-docs-deploy queued for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC by @mike

sam: added python snippet in follow-up PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/731
```python
from redwood_console import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient()
breakdown = client.get_latency_cost(route='/generate')
print('p50:', breakdown['latency']['p50_ms'], 'p95:', breakdown['latency']['p95_ms'], 'est_cost:', breakdown['cost']['estimated'])
```

elaine: perfect — that's exactly what we need. once #731 merges i'll re-run the full docs CI and then we can merge #728. if both land today i'll trigger the console patch release.

julia: CI passed on the snippet fix; one remaining link warning until mike's redirect deploys.

mike: redirect live, re-running linkcheck now.

docs-bot: link-check passed for /docs/console/kv-cache.md

mike: approved and merged #728 after a quick wording tweak. thanks all. :tada:

elaine: awesome work — scheduling the docs patch for tonight's release window. noted follow-ups: add a tiny Node example, and a short eval note about verifying cost numbers after kv-cache changes. i'll file those as issues.

sam: will pick the node snippet tomorrow.

julia: thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
